examples.japanese: {娘婿|むすめむこ}が{遊|あそ}びに{来|き}た。
{娘婿|むすめむこ}は{銀行|ぎんこう}に{勤|つと}めている。
examples.english: My son-in-law works at a bank.

examples.japanese: {娘婿|むすめむこ}に{家業|かぎょう}を{継|つ}いでもらうことになった。
examples.english: We've arranged for our son-in-law to take over the family business.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {娘婿|むすめむこ}を{迎|むか}える: to gain a son-in-law
- {娘婿|むすめむこ}に{継|つ}がせる: to have one's son-in-law take over (a business)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {婿|むこ}: son-in-law; bridegroom — shorter, more general term
- {婿養子|むこようし}: an adopted son-in-law who takes the wife's family name
- {義理|ぎり}の{息子|むすこ}: son-in-law — a more descriptive everyday phrasing
